spec.name: News tone v16
spec.notes: Searched 261 variants of this signal; the figure quoted is the best of them and should be read with that in mind. The family has a long record as a premium.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.1, annual return 3%, maximum drawdown 5%.

exhibits.summary: The log holds 262 distinct specs; the best of 262 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.40, so the claimed 1.10 becomes 0.70 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 98%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.60 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.00, 95th percentile 0.57).
On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 1.40 against 1.14 in research, a gap of -0.26.
The best year gives 52% of total P&L (year 7) and calm regimes give 62%; Sharpe is 1.08 in calm and 1.46 in stressed regimes.
Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.14 to 0.97 (change -0.17).

charges.argument: The strategy's performance is heavily reliant on a single year (year 7) which accounts for 52% of the total P&L, indicating potential overfitting to a lucky period.

rebuttals.argument: The regime_split exhibit shows that while year 7 contributes 52% of the P&L, the Sharpe ratio in calm regimes is 1.08 and in stressed regimes is 1.46, indicating the strategy performs well across different market conditions. This suggests the strategy is not solely reliant on a single year.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's performance is heavily reliant on a single year (year 7) which accounts for 52% of the total P&L, indicating potential overfitting to a lucky period. While the strategy performs well in different regimes, the heavy reliance on one year raises concerns about the robustness of the strategy.
